name: btn-click-down
blurb: Button with drop shadow that compresses down when pressed.
description: A button with a visible drop shadow that translates down and to the right. On active/press, the shadow disappears and the button translates toward the shadow position, simulating a press motion.
use_when: A playful button that should feel responsive and tactile.
avoid_when: Minimalist designs where shadows would feel heavy.
a11y: Native button element with keyboard support.
